title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → DegreeAudit
architecture_notes: Workday Student's Progress to Degree (Academic Progress) evaluates a student's completed and in-progress work against their program's requirements. It is the native degree-audit engine, equivalent to PeopleSoft's Academic Advisement (degree audit / APR). Note: many institutions use a third-party audit tool (DegreeWorks, Stellic) alongside the SIS — document both the native Workday source and the integration pattern.

source_objects.description: Progress-to-degree evaluation: requirements, satisfied/unsatisfied, in-progress. Equivalent to PS_SAA_ADB_RESULTS (Academic Advisement).
Individual requirement (e.g., 'Complete 3 courses from the CS core'). Equivalent to PS_RQ_GRP_DETAIL.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Each audit run has an ID.
Cast to ISO 8601. When the audit was run.

attribute_mappings.source: Derived from satisfied vs total requirements

attribute_mappings.transformation: Total requirement count for the program.
Requirements being met by current enrollment.

notes: If the institution uses DegreeWorks or Stellic instead of native Workday audit, the audit data comes from that system via integration — map the third-party audit output to this same HELIX structure. FERPA-protected.
